paragraphs.text: Sleeps four. Beside a river, two miles from the nearest village. Dogs welcome (maximum two). There is a wood-burning stove, and logs are provided free of charge. Minimum stay three nights.
Sleeps eight. In the centre of the village, close to shops and a pub. Large garden with play equipment. Not suitable for pets. Available for weekly bookings only, Saturday to Saturday.

Sleeps two. A first-floor flat with a balcony overlooking the harbour. There is no parking, but a public car park is five minutes’ walk away. Short breaks available all year. Bed linen and towels are provided.
Sleeps six. A converted barn with wide views across the valley. Electric car charging point. Please note that the track to the barn is steep and unsuitable for low cars.
Sleeps four. Ground-floor bedroom and bathroom, suitable for guests with limited mobility. Ten minutes’ drive to the beach. Free Wi-Fi and a welcome basket of local food.

items.quote: Ground-floor bedroom and bathroom, suitable for guests with limited mobility
items.prompt: is suitable for people who find stairs difficult

explanation.en: “Ground-floor bedroom and bathroom, suitable for guests with limited mobility” → E. Everything is on the ground floor, so no stairs.
explanation.kk: «Ground-floor bedroom and bathroom, suitable for guests with limited mobility» → E. Бәрі бірінші қабатта — баспалдақ керек емес.
explanation.ru: «Ground-floor bedroom and bathroom, suitable for guests with limited mobility» → E. Всё на первом этаже — лестница не нужна.

items.quote: Available for weekly bookings only, Saturday to Saturday
items.prompt: can only be booked for a whole week

explanation.en: “Available for weekly bookings only, Saturday to Saturday” → B. A has a “minimum stay three nights”, not a full week.
explanation.kk: «Available for weekly bookings only, Saturday to Saturday» → B. A-дағы «minimum stay three nights» — толық апта емес.
explanation.ru: «Available for weekly bookings only, Saturday to Saturday» → B. В A «minimum stay three nights» — это не целая неделя.

items.quote: the track to the barn is steep and unsuitable for low cars
items.prompt: warns that the road may be a problem for some cars

explanation.en: “the track to the barn is steep and unsuitable for low cars” → D. C has no parking, but says nothing about the road.
explanation.kk: «the track to the barn is steep and unsuitable for low cars» → D. C-да тұрақ жоқ, бірақ жол туралы ештеңе айтылмаған.
explanation.ru: «the track to the barn is steep and unsuitable for low cars» → D. В C нет парковки, но о дороге ничего не сказано.

items.quote: logs are provided free of charge

explanation.en: Cottage A has a stove, and “logs are provided free of charge” — that is free fuel → A.
explanation.kk: A коттеджінде пеш бар, «logs are provided free of charge» — отын тегін беріледі → A.
explanation.ru: У коттеджа A печь, и «logs are provided free of charge» — дрова и есть бесплатное топливо → A.

items.quote: In the centre of the village, close to shops and a pub

explanation.en: “close to shops and a pub” → B. B is used twice — the instruction has an NB. Cottage A is two miles from the village.
explanation.kk: «close to shops and a pub» → B. B әрпі екінші рет — нұсқаулықта NB бар. A коттеджі, керісінше, ауылдан екі миль жерде.
explanation.ru: «close to shops and a pub» → B. Буква B второй раз — в инструкции есть NB. Коттедж A, наоборот, в двух милях от деревни.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Look at the five holiday cottages, A–E. Which cottage mentions the following? Write the correct letter, A–E. NB You may use any letter more than once.
